notes.title: Update 1.1.5, end story and the official release date!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
It has been a long time since we last notified versions of an update
As of version 1.1.2, we have updated it continuously with 1.1.3, 1.1.4 and latest as of today 1.1.5 without any notice.
So today, version 1.1.5 will mark the end of the game's story. We would like to make a summary of the updates for the latest versions.
Also we will announce the expected official launch date!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36387396/712cd831d778f3e8993798c70f4ce4c4d2dba69f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36387396/81333b6269d4e6f123f453af07aa0ca6fc88a9ca.gif[/img]

[b]In 1.1.3 and 1.1.4, we continued the story and led you to:[/b]
- The Elder God Temple
- Eternal Snow Land
- Encounter with a main-story boss, a hidden boss and a new mini-boss
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36387396/3221a44b92559145c46c214e5a152d45c28b13c9.gif[/img]

[b]In 1.1.5, we added a lot of new content while closing the main story line of the game, here are some highlights:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36387396/10cfaf3b700ac26c75d685af5d3316347ac63ec3.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36387396/ec754400dd824978c38563716ea6675669dc7cf8.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36387396/28d1a3077cea5273449199a79c1e58b9fe51d779.gif[/img]
- Complete the main storyline with 2 new maps and new enemies, puzzles and a lot of cool new bosses throughout the story
- Add a total of 4 side quests in the beginning area, all have bosses!
- A few hidden mini-bosses have been added throughout the game with Steam Achievement as reward.
- Improved loading time when scene changing as well as the time of first starting game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36387396/d11d439b4ab106388d61a34a0bc793be20acbd9d.png[/img]
- Quest Log - a feature which summarizes the progress of both the main quest and the side quest and objective information while progressing
- Add Auto save - now finishing event and praying at the statue will trigger auto-save in a separate slot, not overwrite your own saves.
- Improve the behavior of the enemies to make them smarter and chase harder
- The old maps also have updated their mini-map with hand-drawn images which are easier to see
- Improved battle-mechanics of some old bosses like Gluttony to make it more interesting
- The first boss in the game has also been completely changed
- Traps have been fixed for dealing a fixed amount of damage, that will not kill you in once hit
- Add many new achievements
- Many minor bug fixes and improvement!


Next update and official release date?
The main story of the game is completed and we think the side quests and mini-bosses are enough for GotA, so we will stop developing new content and focus on fixing bugs and improving some important features.
Finally, we plan to release the game officially on May 28! After the official release, we will continue to maintain development of the game and fix any new bugs, as well as improve what is deemed necessary.
Let's we all look forward to it!

notes.title: Official 1.0.8 update and roadmap!
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!
There is a week after we release version 1.0.8 on the public beta branch. And today we bring this version to the official branch for everyone.
If you still want to keep in touch with hourly/daily/weekly updates on the public beta branch, follow the instructions here:
https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1195020/view/1839097781061933722

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36387396/b1799667e1d030ddca4d7f3174c9217eec026331.gif[/img]

There are some news things in the 1.0.8 version:
1. With all 5 playable characters, we always want to make each character look different from the others in the outlook, the sound, and the fighting style.
In this update, we've added a new define called "damage type", which has two types of damage: physical and magic. Based on that, each character will have a certain damage type and the enemy is also resistant to one or both types of damage. This makes a little different and requires you not to be able to just abusing a single character!

2. As the most important part of the update, we added the main storyline after Nel returned from the outside world. You will discover a new dungeon, fight new enemies, new bosses and another secret boss (which can be a little hard to beat, but the rewards are so useful!)

3. Belong to the main storyline, you will be able to unlock 2 new Guardian Spirits. And do not forget, there are 4 great hot hentai scenes when reaching Bond Level milestones in the R18 DLC!

4. In previous versions, many players complained that the control of the characters was not good. So we have a small improvement, that the movement does not stop suddenly but smoothly. Hope you are comfortable with the current controls. Unless, please let us know your ideas and problems, we will find a way to solve it as soon as possible!

5. About game balance, there is no change in the enemy's or character's stat. But there is a very important change in the damage of skills. In previous releases, just only buffs and defensive skills are useful. The offensive skills proved too weak (not much damage). In the new update, attack skills will become stronger and stronger every time the skill level up. So remember to use it often!

6. One more thing about skills, you will find a few new skills useful in this version.

7. Did you feel the chests were trash, and you don't want to find them? Yes, we do.
We deleted all current chests and hide a lot of new chests. The new chests will produce more valuable things like a lot of souls, skills, points or healing seeds. The more hidden chests, the more valuable they are, so don't miss them! 
Note: If you want to experience this update, you have to play a new save slot.

8. The main ideas we've listed above, but there are a lot of bugs that have been fixed, and many other things that your feedback or find out have improved. Writing too much is not a good idea, so we let you feel! Do not forget to leave us your feedback.
To ensure the best experience, starting a new playthrough is the best solution. Playing the old save will sometimes cause conflicts or data duplication or imbalances. Please sympathize with us!

Version 1.0.8 is out, so what about next? Yeah, we always plan ahead for each game timeline, and here are the upcoming plans:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36387396/b119662516275fb4cf1af29abc0a6eabe1f4c312.gif[/img]

1. Of course, the first thing that must be developed during Early Access is the main storyline. Currently, there are many new bosses and missions ready for you to conquer. But wait, we still have a lot of dungeons that need to be completely designed first!

2. As mentioned above, we will continue to make new differences for the characters, including passive skills and special abilities.

3. We will add new puzzles as well as path finding, you will be able to use the special skills of the character to solve them!

4. Side quests - that's right, you didn't hear it wrong! In addition to the main quest, we will gradually put on side quests for you to explore and conquer. This will take a long time, so please wait patiently!

5. How about the new hentai scenes? Surely you really want to know about this right? We will consider doing extra hentai scenes, maybe paid DLC or free depending on the sale report. But that was after the official release of the game. And now there are 10 scenes for you to enjoy!

6. To make up for the lack of new hentai scene, we've done something else for you, which is the animation for the characters that appear in the dialogue. Our animator is finalizing the final characters, and it will soon appear in the game in the coming updates!

7. Enemy is boring! Surely many people after playing through a few maps will feel the same! That's right, we also see that, so we are improving the enemy to make them smarter, add more behaviors and add more special enemies. Trust me, you will like it. 

8. Achievements will be added in some next version.

9. It's enough at this time, the others part is that we will listen to your feedback and make improvements or even new content if it is within our capabilities and does not affect our plans. we!
So, do not hesitate to let us know your ideas! Comment here, post on the community or discord, send mail... We always read your feedback!

CHEERRRR!!!!!!!

notes.title: Version 1.0.7 game balance update!
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!
In several previous updates, because of wrong data input, we made the balance of the game become so much broken!
In this version, we have a bit change to make the game more challenging!
Here is the detail:
- Allysse was too much overpower without any risk. So we decrease her base stats. Especially her magic ball now has a shorter fly range.
- Lynn had high attack speed and high speed-factor when upgrade, so we decrease a bit her base stats and upgrade-factor. It means you will need more soul to make her stronger. Her thunder arrow's attack range is also decreased.
- In previous versions, enemies dropped too many souls. So you were able to upgrade your character freely to become overpowering. Now they have dropped exactly as we want. Therefore you may need a bit consideration in selecting which character's stats to upgrade!
- Some of Nel base stats were very high at the start, so you didn't need to consider most of her stats except HP, so now she will starting with 2 Stamina and 4 SP.
- Shield (Will of Adam) skill is very useful but requires a low cost. So it requires a higher cost now (3 -> 4 SP)
- The damage of attack skills depended on character damage, so it very useless right now. So, in the next update, we will add a damage factor for skill.

Because there is no way to revert data of users who have ever played the game, so for a better experience, you need to start over again or the game will less challenge - that is completely your choice!
In next several versions, we will also update the Chest to made it more rewarded when exploring!

Although we have tried our best, there are still some small places that have not yet been translated into Chinese, we will update more in the next version. During the game, if you encounter any deficiencies, please contact us via the Discord server or Steam Community below to be resolved as soon as possible!

3. In addition to the 2 important updates above, we also update some minor bug fixes! (fix bug white screen of hscene)

We are still working on bug fixes and new content coming next week! Let's wait and check it out!
All of your feedbacks are very valuable and helps Guardians of the Ashes become better!

Dev Team

notes.title: Update 1.0.4 enemy burst damage and minors bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
We just updated GotA to 1.0.4 with changes and bug fixes, here is the detail:
- Sometimes you surrounded by a lot of enemies and got many hits at the same time, then "game over" - there is no way to avoid that. So we added a new mechanic that helps you have time to use heal potion or even run away. That is when your HP is low to zero, you have a bit time to do that without dying. But keep in mind, you will die if you continue combat with them when your HP is low
- Some enemies attack by a pattern with many bullets that have ridiculously high damage. That is not a problem with their base damage, the problem is each bullet have the same base damage. Now the damage will equally be divided into each bullet then the damage is now balanced.
- Boss attack: in previous versions, the boss can have many knockdown attacks continuously that make uncomfortable feeling and sometimes you have no way to standing up, now the problem is gone
- Fixes bug equipped item suddenly change when you rest or use a potion
- Game balance: decrease enemy damage for most area
- Fix unreachable stair in The Maze dungeon
